subject: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — Copperline Health
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@copperlinehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 19:20:00 +0000
Subject: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — Copperline Health

Leah — great to meet today, thanks for the call. Quick recap and a proposed POC approach so we can move to scheduling and procurement: 

Key problems you confirmed:
- High latency for patient record retrieval in your search service (p95 > 400ms)
- Need higher semantic recall for clinical note search and question-answering
- Strict data residency + audit requirements for PHI

Proposed POC objective (6-week baseline):
1) Surface improvement: increase relevant retrieval rate for clinician queries by 20% over current BM25 baseline (measured via QA hit-rate on seed prompt set).
2) Performance: maintain p95 inference latency <= 250ms for single-document QA paths under 50 RPS test load; document end-to-end runbook for scale.
3) Security/compliance: demonstrate network isolation + KMS-backed key usage for logs and model inputs.

Suggested scope & timeline (draft):
- Week 0: kick-off + environment access (VPC peering or S3 share, NDA/procurement docs)
- Week 1–2: ingest sample dataset (anonymized subset), baseline BM25 vs Redwood embeddings comparisons, initial eval harness
- Week 3: model tuning and routing config; latency optimization (batching + kv-cache tuning)
- Week 4: controlled load test and acceptance run; QA on success criteria
- Week 5–6: wrap-up, results review, next-steps (rollout plan or Dedicated sizing)

Owners (Redwood): Vivek (solutions lead), Monica (CS engineering / onboarding), Priyom (integration & infra).
Suggested Copperline owners: Leah (Product), Mark Chen (Infra).

Attachments: poc-outline.pdf (detailed sprint plan), redwood-trial-template.xlsx (acceptance matrix + test cases).

Immediate asks from your side to accelerate:
- Confirm availability for 60-min kickoff Thursday 2027-07-08 or Friday 2027-07-09
- Provide an anonymized sample (S3 / secure share) and a contact for procurement/infosec
- Any contract/procurement templates we should route through now

If that looks good I will drop a calendar invite and loop in our security engineer for the kickoff.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
(Attachment: poc-outline.pdf, redwood-trial-template.xlsx)

From: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@copperlinehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mark.chen@copperlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 20:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — Copperline Health

Thanks Vivek — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side and an initial success criteria list: 

Copperline acceptance criteria (initial, for POC):
- Relevance: top-3 answer contains correct passage for >= 70% of our clinical QA prompt set (we'll provide 300 seed prompts)
- Latency: p95 <= 300ms for single-document QA calls when tested at 25 RPS
- Throughput: system able to sustain 25 RPS for 30 minutes without errors
- Auditability: ability to export logs with request/response hashes, and evidence of KMS encryption at rest

Constraints / procurement notes:
- We must keep PHI within our EU region for a subset of data (we will flag those records) — need to confirm whether Redwood Private or a regional hosted option is best
- We have a preferred DLaaS contract template; procurement will share edits after kickoff

Schedule: Thurs 2027-07-08 16:00 BST / 11:00 ET works for Product + Infra. We can do kickoff then if that suits your side.

I'll attach our internal acceptance checklist (not included here) and will share S3 access once procurement signals green.

—Leah
Leah Ortiz
Senior Product Manager, Copperline Health
leah.ortiz@copperlinehealth.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@copperlinehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@copperlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 13:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed POC plan — Copperline Health

Leah — thanks for the clear criteria and for confirming the kickoff slot. Confirming 08 Jul 2027 11:00 ET for a 60-min kickoff — I'll send an invite in a minute.

Responding to your items and adding a few pragmatic commitments: 

1) Mapping acceptance criteria to measurable tests
- Relevance: we'll run your 300 seed prompts through both (a) current BM25 pipeline and (b) Redwood embeddings + rerank; primary metric = top-3 hit-rate (binary correct/incorrect judged by your QA reviewers). We'll provide per-prompt diffs and aggregated delta.
- Latency / Throughput: we'll instrument p95/p50 and error rate under a 25 RPS 30-minute soak. We'll provide the load harness and test instructions.
- Auditability: we'll enable request-level logging with request IDs and SHA256 response hashes. For the POC we'll demonstrate KMS-wrapped keys for stored artifacts; for EU-resident PHI we recommend Private deployment or a regionally hosted dedicated pool — we can scope that in kickoff.

2) Technical approach highlights
- Model selection: start with open large-retrieval tuned model (redwood-rl1-small) for throughput; failover to a higher-accuracy variant for rerank only.
- Batching & cache configuration: Monica will propose batching window and kv-cache TTL values after we review sequence-length distribution of your seed prompts.
- Data handling: Priyom will provide ingestion guidance and a minimal transform script for anonymization if needed.

3) Ownership & immediate next steps
- Redwood: Vivek (solutions lead / main contact), Monica (CS engineering, onboarding lead), Priyom (integration & infra).
- Copperline: Leah (Product), Mark (Infra), Procurement contact TBD.

Immediate asks for kickoff prep (action items):
- Copperline: share S3 read-only link or permissioned dataset + list of 300 seed prompts (due by 2027-07-09)
- Redwood: drop kickoff invite (+ agenda), attach poc-outline.pdf and trial acceptance sheet; prepare initial eval harness and a short onboarding playbook

Logistics & procurement: we can run the POC on Redwood Hosted with a regionally isolated pool if Procurement prefers managed. If Copperline requires PHI stay in EU for any dataset slices we will flag Private deployment as the fastest path to compliance — we'll review tradeoffs in kickoff.

Links & attachments: poc-outline.pdf (detailed week-by-week tasks), redwood-trial-template.xlsx (acceptance cases). Kickoff invite coming now. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DL-2027-0783

See you on Thursday — Vivek
